architecture: 1 layer LSTM/GRU hidden=32 + Dense32/ReLU/Dense1; predict residual over persistence
scaler: train windows only; flattened overlapping timestamps weighted by occurrence
selection: chronological validation RMSE checkpoint, no evaluation tuning
split_rule: train target < validation start; validation origin >= validation start and target < evaluation start; evaluation origin >= evaluation start and target < evaluation end
era5_caveat: retrospective valid-time inputs, publication latency not simulated
evaluation_caveat: all evaluation periods lie in previously inspected historical data; roll_3 overlaps v1 test; exploratory, not fresh holdout
comparison_caveat: RNN receives 16 observations of all weather fields; tree uses same power history but weather at origin only; algorithm and representation both differ
